identity: Hearthpine cuts the pit props for the Copperfell shafts; this year the woods bite back, and a gang of ore thieves under a chief called Bracket is carting off what the shift digs.

quests.title: A Pig's Breakfast
quests.text: Small Boars are rooting through our pit props {zone_area:timberline}, and I refuse to lose a miner to a pig's breakfast. Kill eight by day; a yellow name means they leave you be until you strike. Save any meat for Hilda, then we'll see about the ore thieves.
quests.lesson: Yellow names are neutral single pulls; keep the meat.

quests.title: Hands Before Heroics
quests.text: Before you go making a name for yourself, make something with a handle. Craft a Wooden Axe and a Wooden Pickaxe and bring both to me here in Hearthpine. A miner's first tools hang on the hall wall for luck, so yours go up beside your grandmother's, and you take a seasoned pair from the rack in their place.
quests.lesson: Grid crafting of the first tools; turned-in tools are replaced.

quests.title: Feed the Fire First
quests.text: Every mouth in Hearthpine wants supper, including the smokehouse. Bring me five logs from trees outside town, at any hour; logs, mind, not planks. Leave the town trees standing, or you'll answer to Brunna before you answer to me.
quests.lesson: Any log counts; planks do not; protected town trees cannot be cut.

quests.title: The Unpaid Night Crew
quests.text: Our timber has acquired a night crew with teeth and no respect for joinery. Kill eight Large Rats {zone_area:timberline} after dark. A red name means they'll attack on sight, and a rat's squeal brings nearby rats running; pick your fights before they pick you.
quests.lesson: Night clock and red names; rats call nearby rats.

quests.title: An Edge Worth Keeping
quests.text: Good, you've learned which end to hold. Take your Wooden Pickaxe to plain rock outside the walls, then craft a Stone Axe and a Stone Pickaxe and bring both for inspection. I'll swap them for a fresh pair; the next rock won't yield to wood and encouragement.
quests.lesson: Pick tiers gate rock; stone tools open the next rock.

quests.title: Supper Needs a Spark
quests.text: A cold oven is just a cupboard with ambitions. Mine five Coal Lumps from the rock outside town and bring them to me when you have a break from hunting. Try the public oven while you're here: coal in the fuel slot, raw food in the cooking slot, and patience until supper.
quests.lesson: Gathering while waiting for night; the public oven stands in town.

quests.title: Mending at the Rats' Expense
quests.text: The rats have eaten at my expense and chewed through my flour sacks, so they can pay for the mending. Bring me two Rat Fur Patches from the Large Rats in the {name:timberline} after nightfall.
quests.lesson: Ordinary family loot answers a pantry request.

quests.title: The Dead Can Clock Out
quests.text: I know a dragging footstep after a hard shift, and those aren't tired miners. Kill eight Braindead Zombies on the {name:shingle} {dir_from_giver:shingle} after nightfall. They burn in sunlight, so get your daytime work done while you wait. The dead can have your next shift.
quests.lesson: Zombies come at night and burn in the sun.

quests.title: A Hard Hat Has Limits
quests.text: Young Ibex are kicking slate onto the path through the {name:high_pines}, which lie {zone_area:high_pines}. Hunt eight by day; they'll graze peaceably until you start the fight. Our skulls are sturdy, but I'd rather not test them against the whole hillside.
quests.lesson: A daytime hunt beside the night work; ibex are neutral grazers.

quests.title: Winter Doesn't Bring Lunch
quests.text: When the snow shuts us in, I mean to hear snoring, not stomachs. Bring me ten pieces of Raw Meat for the winter racks; what you've saved counts, or hunt boar and ibex by day and rats by night here in Hearthpine Vale. I'll send you off with three portions of Meat, because the cook gets the last word on leaving hungry.
quests.lesson: Earlier hunting loot pays a later request.

quests.title: Fittings Before Fortune
quests.text: A shaft prop is only as trustworthy as its fittings, and miners put their lives beneath ours. Smelt three Copper Bars and three Tin Bars from the local ore and bring them to me. I'll give you a Dual Furnace for your own work; set it up outside protected ground, because the hall has rules about open fires and I wrote most of them.
quests.lesson: Ore to bar; a dual furnace takes two inputs.

quests.title: The Feast Fights Back
quests.text: For once I'd like a feast that nobody can mistake for yesterday's stew. Bring me three Crab Legs from Small Crabs or Monstrous Crabs at the {name:rockpools} {dir_from_giver:rockpools} by day. Small Crabs leave you alone until provoked; Monstrous Crabs start the argument themselves, so keep all your fingers for the cutlery.
quests.lesson: Shore strips by day; neutral and aggressive crabs share the rocks.

quests.title: Your Next Bite of Mountain
quests.text: Those Copper Bars and Tin Bars are holding up mine shafts now, so you'll need fresh supplies for this. Use your Dual Furnace to make three Bronze Bars and bring them to me here. You've earned a Bronze Pickaxe and a crack at tougher rock; remember who taught you when you strike something worth bragging about.
quests.lesson: Alloys need fresh inputs; the Bronze Pickaxe is the onward tool.

quests.title: Bracket Doesn't Add Up
quests.text: Bracket has written our ore into his ledger as though stealing it were a trade. Go to the {name:ore_thief_camp} {dir_from_giver:ore_thief_camp}, where his crew lurks day and night, and defeat seven Confused Ore Thieves and Confused Ore Chief Bracket himself. Draw the chief away from his crew if you can; I'd like his ledger closed without your name entered in it.
quests.lesson: Seven helpers and one normal named leader; pull the chief alone.

quests.title: Follow the Missing Ore
quests.text: You put an end to Bracket's stealing, but his carts already took our ore to Copperfell. Follow the main road to Copperfell Village and tell Orrik Pineledger what happened. Finish any business here first; Hearthpine sends you off with pride, not a boot to the backside.
quests.lesson: Start to home zone handoff at level 9 to 10.
